[[File:Caltrop_field.png|thumb|right|300px|Ki-Adi-Mundi cuts through a Geonosian caltrop field during the Second Battle of Geonosis.]]
A '''caltrop field''' was a field of large spikes in the ground on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] was forced to use his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut through several [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] caltrops to allow his one surviving [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] to proceed to the landing zone where the three [[General/Legends|Generals]] commanding the attack were to rendezvous.<ref name="Landing">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>
